drafted_from: tool:count-a-characters-turns-from-caption-marks's row in tools/measure-a-characters-voice-lines-and-staging/tool-rows.json, its script in tools/measure-a-characters-voice-lines-and-staging/do-work/ and the tests in tools/measure-a-characters-voice-lines-and-staging/test/
start_here: Say to your AI: "Count the parrot's turns in my episodes from the >> marks in the captions and the pitch of each turn." It runs tool:count-a-characters-turns-from-caption-marks on your computer and writes character-caption-turns.tsv.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it reads one settings row of yours (record:setting:measure-a-characters-voice-lines-and-staging~<scope_kind>~<scope_id>) or the settings you pass, and works on files in the show's folder.
instructions: 1. Clone the repository https://github.com/Trillion-X/trillion-workshop and check the needs listed on the row (python 3 and its libraries, ffmpeg where named).

2. Your AI reads the row with run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools, method tools:list and input {"tool":"tool:count-a-characters-turns-from-caption-marks"}, saves your settings row (records:read record:setting:measure-a-characters-voice-lines-and-staging~<scope_kind>~<scope_id>) to a file and puts it in the request as settings_record, or passes settings.

3. It runs: python3 -I trillion-workshop/tools/measure-a-characters-voice-lines-and-staging/do-work/count_caption_turns.py < REQUEST.json. It needs the catalog (tool:catalog-a-channels-videos-by-format), each episode's captions with at least five >> marks and its <id>.emb.npz (find_voice.py embed); ratio in the request wins over the setting.
4. Compare its character_s per episode with that of tool:find-when-a-character-speaks and tell the person where the two disagree most.

worked_examples.title: One episode, one high-pitched turn of five
worked_examples.ask: Count the parrot's turns from the caption marks.
worked_examples.given: From CaptionTurnsTest in tools/measure-a-characters-voice-lines-and-staging/test/test_measures.py. The AI reads the row with tools:list, then runs python3 -I trillion-workshop/tools/measure-a-characters-voice-lines-and-staging/do-work/count_caption_turns.py < REQUEST.json with REQUEST.json = {"data_folder": "show", "youtube_folder": "youtube", "extra_voice_folders": ["elsewhere"], "settings": {"caption_turn_pitch_ratio": 1.6}}. Episode vid-a has captions with five >> marks (at 2, 10, 14, 20 and 22 s) and a pitch track at 110 Hz except 300 Hz from 9.25 to 13 s.
worked_examples.hands_back: {"result": {"table": "show/character-caption-turns.tsv", "videos": 1}}; the table row is vid-a, caption_turns 5, character_turns 1 (the turn from 10 s), character_s 4.0, character_s_first5min 4.0, episode_median_f0 110.0. With ratio 3 in the request the same run counts character_turns 0.
